WITH u AS (
  SELECT 'festas' AS parte, company_id, created_at FROM public.company_events
  UNION ALL SELECT 'pre_reservas', company_id, created_at FROM public.pre_reservations
  UNION ALL SELECT 'visitas', company_id, created_at FROM public.lead_visits
  UNION ALL SELECT 'tarefas', company_id, created_at FROM public.company_tasks
  UNION ALL SELECT 'equipe_festa', company_id, created_at FROM public.event_staff_entries
  UNION ALL SELECT 'presenca', company_id, created_at FROM public.attendance_entries
  UNION ALL SELECT 'manutencao', company_id, created_at FROM public.maintenance_entries
  UNION ALL SELECT 'acompanhamento', company_id, created_at FROM public.party_monitoring_entries
  UNION ALL SELECT 'informacoes', company_id, created_at FROM public.event_info_entries
  UNION ALL SELECT 'checklist', company_id, created_at FROM public.event_checklist_items
  UNION ALL SELECT 'pagamentos', company_id, created_at FROM public.event_payments
  UNION ALL SELECT 'contratos', company_id, created_at FROM public.generated_contracts
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dados_cliente', company_id, created_at FROM public.client_data_requests
  UNION ALL SELECT 'aval_freelancer', company_id, created_at FROM public.freelancer_evaluations
)
SELECT u.parte, co.name AS empresa, count(*) AS total,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.created_at > now() - interval '90 days') AS ultimos_90d,
       max(u.created_at)::date AS ultimo
FROM u JOIN public.companies co ON co.id = u.company_id
GROUP BY u.parte, co.name
ORDER BY u.parte, total DESC
